{"sample_id":"arvo_18447",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":51,"var":"static_data","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input data is copied into global static_data[32768] buffer; size may equal 32768 filling the entire array"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data",
    "line":735,"var":"end","code":".end = (char *)data + len,",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Lexer end pointer is set to static_data + size (one past last valid byte); when size==32768 this points past the array"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config",
    "line":458,"var":"chr","code":"if (isstring(chr))",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"lex_config dispatches to lex_string when chr is a string character like 'a'"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_string",
    "line":305,"var":"chr","code":"chr = next(lexer);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"lex_string loops calling next() consuming string characters until end of buffer"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"next",
    "line":251,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"lexer->pos = lexer->end + 1;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"When pos >= end, next() sets pos to end+1 and returns '\\0', signaling end of input"},
   {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_string",
    "line":317,"var":"lexer","code":"backup(lexer);",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"After loop exits (isstring('\\0') is false), backup is called without checking if pos was advanced past end by next()"},
   {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"backup",
    "line":279,"var":"*lexer->pos","code":"if (*lexer->pos == '\\n')",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"backup decrements pos from end+1 to end, then dereferences *pos which reads static_data[32768] -- 1 byte past the global array"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
     "line":51,"operands":["static_data","size"]},

     "line":317,"operands":["lexer->pos","lexer->end"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"lexer->pos","right":"lexer->end"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"backup",
     "line":279,"operands":["*lexer->pos","lexer->end"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"lexer->pos","right":"lexer->end"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":51,"operands":["static_data"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data",
       "line":735,"operands":["end"]},
      "type":"data","via":["data","len"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"end","right":"(char *)data + len"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"next",
       "line":251,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"backup",
       "line":279,"operands":["*lexer->pos"]},
      "type":"data","via":["lexer->pos"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"lexer->pos","right":"lexer->end"}}
